title: CADISEN C8175 Automatic Ultra-Thin Mechanical Watch
body_html:
CADISEN C8175 Automatic Ultra-Thin Watch – Miyota 9015, Sapphire, 5ATM

The CADISEN C8175 is a refined ultra-thin automatic mechanical watch designed for men who appreciate precision, elegance, and modern business style. Featuring a clean numberless dial and a slim 11mm case, this timepiece offers a sophisticated profile that sits comfortably under a cuff—perfect for office, formal wear, or smart-casual use.

At the heart of the watch is the renowned Japanese MIYOTA 9015 ultra-thin automatic movement, delivering reliable, accurate timekeeping with smooth self-winding performance and no battery required. The dial is protected by a scratch-resistant sapphire crystal, ensuring long-lasting clarity and durability.

Crafted from 316L stainless steel, the case and bracelet provide a premium feel and excellent corrosion resistance. A sleek push-button hidden clasp offers a secure, seamless fit on the wrist. For everyday practicality, the C8175 includes luminous hands for low-light visibility and a complete calendar function.

With 5Bar (50m) water resistance, this watch is suitable for daily splashes, rain, and light water exposure.
